Manuš okkole hibare Ibroni bašat hota hodde funi ekkubare nizam oi giyegoi. Hetunot Paulose hodde:

"Ãi ekzon Ihudi, Kilikiyar Tarsus šohorot ãr zormo, kintu ãi ei šohorot ḍõr oiyi. Ãi Gamlielor ṭengor ḍake boiyore ãrar bafdadar dinna ainor babute furafuri šikka faiyi. Tũwara zendilla Allar babute issawala hendilla ãi o issawala aššilam.
Isar ei fõtot zara solito hitarar uwore ãi beši mot foijjonto zulum goritam. Ar furuš fuwain edde mayafuwain okkolore dori ziyolot ditam.

Ei hota soiyide hiyanor goba oilde ḍõr imam edde dórmo komiṭir beggun, enki ãi itarar hãsottu Damaskusor dormiyo neta okkolore dibolla seṛi failam edde ei manuš okkolore dori ani Zeruzalemot šaza dibolla ãi heṛe gilam.
"Ṭaim onumanik dũijja, zẽtte ãi Damaskusor hãsa hãsi aišši, toi atikka ãr sairo ḍakottu asmanottu ekkan ujjol fohoror šoṛak foijjil.
Ãi meṛit fori gilamboi edde ar ãre hodde ek abaz fuinni,

content.text: 'Saul, Saul, tui ãr uwore kiyolla zulum goror?'

content: "Ãi fusar gorilam, 'Malik õne honnuwa?' "Hibaye hodde,

content.text: 'Ãi Nasarator Isa, zar uwore tui zulum goror.'

content: Zara ãr fũwati aššil hitara o he fohoror šoṛakore deikke, kintu ze ãr loi hota hoiye hibar hota hitara buzi no fare.
"'Malik, ãi ki goritam?'" hoi ãi fusar goijjilam. "Malike hoil,

content.text: 'Tui uṛi Damaskusot za. Tolla ziyan ṭik gori raka oiye hiyan heṛe tore howa oibo.'

content: Toi ãr fũwajja okkole ãre hate dori dori loigiye, kiyollahoile he ujjol fohoror šoṛake ãi anda oigilamboi.
"Toi heṛe Ananiyas name ekzon allawala edde Musar ain biššaši manuše ãre saito aiššil. Heṛiyar har Ihudi okkole hibare beši ijjot gorito.
Hibaye ãr ḍake aiyore tiyaiye edde hodde, 'Bái Saul, dor, tor sukor rošni firi aiyok' Ar hehon ãi hibare suke deki farilam.
"Toi hibaye hodde: 'Ãrar bafdadar Allaye tore basi loiye zene tui hibar issa zani faros, ar he niyaiwalare, mani Isa Mosir deha fos edde hibar mukottu hota funi faros.
Kiyollahoile tui zin deikkos edde fuinnos he babute har mainšor hãse hibar goba oibi.
Ehon tui kiyolla deri goror? Uṭ, torikotor gusol lo edde Isar name ḍakiyore tor gunare duifela.'
"Bade ãi Zeruzalem firi aiyore zehon ekdin dormogórot munazat goijjilam, hetunot ãi ek deha failam.
Ar dekidde Malike ãr loi hota hor. Hibaye ãre hodde:

content.text: 'Toratori gor! Ehon tui Zeruzalem sari zagoi, kiyollahoile eṛiyar mainše ãr babute tor goba diya no funibo.'

content: "Ãi hoiyi, 'Malik, ei manuš okkole zane, zara tũwar uwore biššaš anito hitarare mardor gori ziyolot dibolla ãi ek muzolišhanattu ar ek sinagog okkolot zaitam.
Zẽtte tũwar goba doya Stifanore kun gora oil hẽtte ãi heṛe aššilam. Zara hibare kun goijjil ãi hitarar foikka aššilam edde hitarar hor sõllilam.'
"Toi Malike ãre hodde,

content.text: 'Tui za, ãi tore dure Oihudi okkolor hãse defeṛair.'

content: Manuš okkol etun foijjonto Paulosor hota funi aššil, kintu ehon hitara uzor di howa šuru goijje, "Itare duniyaittu dur goro! Ite zinda takibar laikka no!"
Hitara guzojje edde hitarar gar hor kuli mela maijje edde asmanor mikka dul ura šuru goijje.

Hetunot šoinno okkolor boroye Paulosore šoinno okkolor berekot loi zaibolla hokum diye. Hite Paulosore souk maribolla edde kiyolla manuš okkole Paulosor berudde guzora guzori gorer hiyan zera goribolla hokum diye.
Paulosore zehon souk maribolla bainde, hetunot heṛe ekzon ofisar tiyai aššil. Paulose hitare hodde, "Hosurbon ṭorai no faro de hendilla ekzon Romiyo mainšore souk mara iyan ki ain mozin or?"
Ei hota ofisare funiyore hite šoinno okkolor borore hodde, "Ei manušwa ekzon Romiyo nagorik."
Toi he šoinno okkolor boroye Paulosor hãse zaiyore hodde, "Sai hosai, tui ki Romiyo nagorik?" Paulose hodde, "Oi, ãi oi."
Šoinno okkolor boroye hodde, "Ãi nagorik oibolla ãttu beši ṭĩya diya foijje." Paulose hodde, "Kintu ãi zormo oiyi loti ekzon nagorik."
Ei hota funi zara hibare zera goijjil hitara hehon hentu šori giyegoi. Ar hiba ze Romiyo ei hota šoinno okkolor boroye buzi fariyore hite ḍoraiye.
Ihudi dórmo komiṭir sarme Paulos

Ihudi okkole Paulosore kiyolla hosurbon goijjil hiyan soiyi gori zanibolla saiye. Tarforor din šoinno okkolor boroye Paulosor ban kuli diye edde ḍõr imam okkol edde dórmo komiṭir manuš okkolore ekku fũwati dola oibolla hokum diye. Tarfore hite Paulosore loi ani hitarar sarme tiya goraiye.
